text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah! So that knitted coaster really 
was...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. I made it... for Vivlos-san's 
birthday."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Wow, I'm so happy~♡ You should've 
just told me right away!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm not really confident you'll like 
it... ...I might have gone a bit 
overboard.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It had such a sharp, soaring shape, right? 
With the top shooting way up high! That 
was based on that tower in Dubai, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A-At first, I was thinking of something 
normal. Like adorable sweets or 
fancy-looking accessories that Vivlos-san 
might like...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, you have many friends. If my gift 
were to overlap with someone else's, it 
might disappoint you... As I was pondering 
that—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That one! I thought it was super-duper 
cute! Plus, it's for me, right? It's mine, 
right? I'm sooooo happy♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Messiah-san♪ Drinking black tea 
with that coaster will make me feel like a 
total celebrity♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's brew some tea after our 
bath. I have a muscat tea I'd love to 
recommend.
